title: SPXI Self-Audit Protocol: Embedded Provenance Verification for Composition-Layer Retrieval (EA-SPXI-SELFAUDIT-01 v1.0)
creator: Lee Sharks
description:
A v1.0 protocol specification by Lee Sharks defining the **SPXI Self-Audit Block**, a compact provenance and meaning-preservation structure to be embedded in documents intended for machine retrieval and summarization.

The block declares author, identifier, institution, designation, canonical key terms, a provenance kernel, audit targets, a non-erasure condition, and a canary test. It is designed to make provenance loss and distinction-collapse detectable by comparing a summary with the source block. The protocol further recommends distributing provenance refrains through major sections to survive RAG chunking. It does not technically compel compliance, and its planned JSON-LD, RO-Crate, hash, PROV-O, and command-line layers were future work in v1.0.
